data: For fiscal 2024, Tesla reported total revenues of $97,690 million (about $97.7 billion) for the year ended December 31, 2024, and NVIDIA reported revenue of $60,922 million (about $60.9 billion) for its fiscal year ended January 28, 2024. Tesla's revenue was therefore about 1.60 times NVIDIA's, roughly $36.8 billion more. The two "fiscal 2024" periods do not line up, though. NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 covers mostly calendar 2023, while Tesla's matches calendar 2024. NVIDIA's revenue grew from $26,974 million in fiscal 2023, about 126%, while Tesla's rose only about 0.9% from $96,773 million in 2023. NVIDIA's later fiscal 2025, ending in January 2025, would overlap Tesla's year more closely, but it is not in the extracts provided.
